# `<sl-tab-group>` — Tab Group

Tab groups organize content into a container that shows one section at a time.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | — | `top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end` | `'top'` | The placement of the tabs. |
| `activation` | — | `auto`, `manual` | `'auto'` | When set to auto, navigating tabs with the arrow keys will instantly show the corresponding tab panel. When set to manual, the tab will receive focus but will not show until the user presses spacebar or enter. |
| `no-scroll-controls` | `noScrollControls` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the scroll arrows that appear when tabs overflow. |
| `fixed-scroll-controls` | `fixedScrollControls` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevent scroll buttons from being hidden when inactive. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-tab-show` | `{ name: String }` | Emitted when a tab is shown. |
| `sl-tab-hide` | `{ name: String }` | Emitted when a tab is hidden. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `show(panel: string)` | Shows the specified tab panel. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Used for grouping tab panels in the tab group. Must be `<sl-tab-panel>` elements. |
| `nav` | Used for grouping tabs in the tab group. Must be `<sl-tab>` elements. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `nav` | The tab group's navigation container where tabs are slotted in. |
| `tabs` | The container that wraps the tabs. |
| `active-tab-indicator` | The line that highlights the currently selected tab. |
| `body` | The tab group's body where tab panels are slotted in. |
| `scroll-button` | The previous/next scroll buttons that show when tabs are scrollable, an `<sl-icon-button>`. |
| `scroll-button--start` | The starting scroll button. |
| `scroll-button--end` | The ending scroll button. |
| `scroll-button__base` | The scroll button's exported `base` part. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--indicator-color` | — | The color of the active tab indicator. |
| `--track-color` | — | The color of the indicator's track (the line that separates tabs from panels). |
| `--track-width` | — | The width of the indicator's track (the line that separates tabs from panels). |

## Documentation and examples

Tab groups make use of [tabs](tab.md) and [tab panels](tab-panel.md). Each tab must be slotted into the `nav` slot and its `panel` must refer to a tab panel of the same name.

```html
<sl-tab-group>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="custom">Custom</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="advanced">Advanced</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="disabled" disabled>Disabled</sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="custom">This is the custom tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="advanced">This is the advanced tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="disabled">This is a disabled tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab/tab.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-panel/tab-panel.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tab-group-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-tab-group>
      <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
      <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="custom">Custom</sl-tab>
      <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="advanced">Advanced</sl-tab>
      <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="disabled" disabled>Disabled</sl-tab>

      <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
      <sl-tab-panel name="custom">This is the custom tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
      <sl-tab-panel name="advanced">This is the advanced tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
      <sl-tab-panel name="disabled">This is a disabled tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
    </sl-tab-group>
  `
})
export class TabGroupExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Tabs on Bottom

Tabs can be shown on the bottom by setting `placement` to `bottom`.

```html
<sl-tab-group placement="bottom">
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="custom">Custom</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="advanced">Advanced</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="disabled" disabled>Disabled</sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="custom">This is the custom tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="advanced">This is the advanced tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="disabled">This is a disabled tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>
```

### Closable Tabs

Add the `closable` attribute to a tab to show a close button. This example shows how you can dynamically remove tabs from the DOM when the close button is activated.

```html
<sl-tab-group class="tabs-closable">
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="closable-1" closable>Closable 1</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="closable-2" closable>Closable 2</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="closable-3" closable>Closable 3</sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="closable-1">This is the first closable tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="closable-2">This is the second closable tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="closable-3">This is the third closable tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>

<script>
  const tabGroup = document.querySelector('.tabs-closable');

  tabGroup.addEventListener('sl-close', async event => {
    const tab = event.target;
    const panel = tabGroup.querySelector(`sl-tab-panel[name="${tab.panel}"]`);

    // Show the previous tab if the tab is currently active
    if (tab.active) {
      tabGroup.show(tab.previousElementSibling.panel);
    }

    // Remove the tab + panel
    tab.remove();
    panel.remove();
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab/tab.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-panel/tab-panel.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, ElementRef, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import type SlTabGroup from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.component.js';

interface Tab {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  body: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tabs-closable-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-tab-group #group (sl-close)="close($event)">
      <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
      @for (tab of tabs(); track tab.name) {
        <sl-tab slot="nav" [panel]="tab.name" closable>{{ tab.label }}</sl-tab>
      }

      <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
      @for (tab of tabs(); track tab.name) {
        <sl-tab-panel [name]="tab.name">{{ tab.body }}</sl-tab-panel>
      }
    </sl-tab-group>
  `
})
export class TabsClosableExampleComponent {
  private readonly group = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SlTabGroup>>('group');

  readonly tabs = signal<Tab[]>([
    { name: 'closable-1', label: 'Closable 1', body: 'This is the first closable tab panel.' },
    { name: 'closable-2', label: 'Closable 2', body: 'This is the second closable tab panel.' },
    { name: 'closable-3', label: 'Closable 3', body: 'This is the third closable tab panel.' }
  ]);

  close(event: Event) {
    const tab = event.target as HTMLElement & { panel: string; active: boolean };
    const index = this.tabs().findIndex(candidate => candidate.name === tab.panel);

    if (index === -1) return;

    // Move to the previous tab before removing the active one, otherwise no panel would be shown.
    if (tab.active) {
      const previous = this.tabs()[index - 1];
      this.group().nativeElement.show(previous ? previous.name : 'general');
    }

    this.tabs.update(list => list.filter(candidate => candidate.name !== tab.panel));
  }
}
```

### Fixed scroll controls

When tabs are scrolled all the way to one side, the scroll button on that side can't be clicked. Set the `fixed-scroll-controls` attribute to keep the effected button visible in that case.

### Tabs with Icons

Add a leading `<sl-icon>` inside a tab's default slot to pair it with a label. The active tab indicator is drawn automatically by `<sl-tab-group>` and needs no extra markup per tab.

```html
<sl-tab-group>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="comments" active>
    <sl-icon name="chat"></sl-icon>
    Review Comments
  </sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="dashboard">
    <sl-icon name="grid"></sl-icon>
    Dashboard
  </sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="revisions">
    <sl-icon name="clock-history"></sl-icon>
    Revisions
  </sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="comments">This is the review comments tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="dashboard">This is the dashboard tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="revisions">This is the revisions tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>
```

### Card Tabs with Counters

Set the `card` attribute on a tab to draw it as a bordered card, and pair it with a trailing `<sl-badge pill>` to show a count. Useful for workflow stage switchers.

```html
<sl-tab-group class="tabs-card" style="--track-width: 0;">
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="pva" card>
    PVA
    <sl-badge variant="neutral" pill>22</sl-badge>
  </sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="consolidation" card>
    Consolidation
    <sl-badge variant="neutral" pill>22</sl-badge>
  </sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="review" card active>
    Review
    <sl-badge variant="primary" pill>11</sl-badge>
  </sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="pva">This is the PVA tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="consolidation">This is the consolidation tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="review">This is the review tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>

<style>
  .tabs-card::part(tabs) {
    gap: var(--sl-spacing-small);
  }
</style>

<script>
  const tabGroup = document.querySelector('.tabs-card');

  tabGroup.addEventListener('sl-tab-show', event => {
    tabGroup.querySelectorAll('sl-tab[card]').forEach(tab => {
      const badge = tab.querySelector('sl-badge');
      badge.variant = tab.panel === event.detail.name ? 'primary' : 'neutral';
    });
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/badge/badge.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab/tab.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-panel/tab-panel.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, signal } from '@angular/core';

interface CardTab {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  count: number;
  body: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tabs-card-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  styles: `
    sl-tab-group::part(tabs) {
      gap: var(--sl-spacing-small);
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <sl-tab-group style="--track-width: 0;" (sl-tab-show)="activate($event)">
      @for (tab of tabs; track tab.name) {
        <sl-tab slot="nav" [panel]="tab.name" card [active]="tab.name === active()">
          {{ tab.label }}
          <sl-badge [variant]="tab.name === active() ? 'primary' : 'neutral'" pill>{{ tab.count }}</sl-badge>
        </sl-tab>
      }

      @for (tab of tabs; track tab.name) {
        <sl-tab-panel [name]="tab.name">{{ tab.body }}</sl-tab-panel>
      }
    </sl-tab-group>
  `
})
export class TabsCardExampleComponent {
  readonly active = signal('review');

  readonly tabs: CardTab[] = [
    { name: 'pva', label: 'PVA', count: 22, body: 'This is the PVA tab panel.' },
    { name: 'consolidation', label: 'Consolidation', count: 22, body: 'This is the consolidation tab panel.' },
    { name: 'review', label: 'Review', count: 11, body: 'This is the review tab panel.' }
  ];

  activate(event: Event) {
    this.active.set((event as CustomEvent<{ name: string }>).detail.name);
  }
}
```

### Manual Activation

When focused, keyboard users can press [[Left]] or [[Right]] to select the desired tab. By default, the corresponding tab panel will be shown immediately (automatic activation). You can change this behavior by setting `activation="manual"` which will require the user to press [[Space]] or [[Enter]] before showing the tab panel (manual activation).

```html
<sl-tab-group activation="manual">
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="general">General</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="custom">Custom</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="advanced">Advanced</sl-tab>
  <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="disabled" disabled>Disabled</sl-tab>

  <sl-tab-panel name="general">This is the general tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="custom">This is the custom tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="advanced">This is the advanced tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
  <sl-tab-panel name="disabled">This is a disabled tab panel.</sl-tab-panel>
</sl-tab-group>
```

## Figma

> **Tip:** The Figma Tab Group master holds up to 7 tabs. Tabs 5–7 are turned on with the booleans `Tab 5`, `Tab 6` and
> `Tab 7` (off by default); Code Connect emits a tab and its panel only when its boolean is on.
